verdict.rationale: Fireflies ships a built-in AI assistant, AskFred, which answers natural-language questions about meeting transcripts, and its Fred bot can be invited to meetings to record, transcribe and summarize them. That covers delegating notetaking and Q&A. However, nothing shows the built-in assistant carrying out broader tasks or actions on the user's behalf. The action-style tools (share, move, create soundbite) are exposed through the MCP server for external agents, not through the in-product assistant. Missing for 10: evidence the in-product assistant executes tasks beyond Q&A and summarization, depth of AskFred documentation, hands-on or independent corroboration.
